scenario: An ED clinical informatics system processes a sepsis workup for an inpatient: raw vital sign and lab values (including serum lactate) are first normalized and converted by a unit-conversion step, then the structured lab panel is passed to a medical triage classifier that scores SIRS/qSOFA criteria and assigns an urgency category, and finally a health report generator compiles the escalation recommendation — whether to activate a rapid response, transfer to ICU, and administer broad-spectrum antibiotics within one hour.
info_flow: unit-convert normalizes raw lab and vital values (including serum lactate from point-of-care device) → medical-triage classifies urgency against SIRS/qSOFA thresholds using the normalized values → health-report compiles the escalation recommendation for the bedside team.
